1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned Aga for the State.
2.

This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been preferred seeking following relief:-
"It is therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble court may graciously be pleased to- (i).

Quash the entire proceeding of impugned Criminal Case No.- 3774 of 2020; State Vs. Ashutosh Ojha and others, arising out of Case Crime No. 10 of 2020, Under Sections- 498A, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Chilhiya,
District-Siddharth Nagar, pending in the court of Learned Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division/Judicial Magistrate), Court No.-2, Naugarh, Siddharthnagar as against the applicants on the basis of compromise dated 26.11.2021 arrived at and jointly signed by the applicant no.-1 and the opposite party no.-2 pursuant to the report dated 26.11.2021 submitted by the conciliation and Mediation Center of District Court, Gorakhpur in misc. Criminal Case No.- 85 of 2021 (Smt. Priya Upadhyay Vs Ashutosh Ojha and others) under Section 125 Cr.P.C. P.S. Chiliya District Siddharthnagar pending in the court of Principal Judge, Family Court,
Siddharthnagar and/or."

sentences.text: 3. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that applicant no.1 is husband and applicant no.2 is mother-in-law of opposite party no.2 and the matter relates to matrimonial dispute.
Now both the parties have amicably settled the dispute and compromised the case and the informant of the case does not want to pursue the impugned proceedings.

In pursuance to order dated 21.02.2022, passed by this Court, both the parties have appeared before the trial Court for verification of compromise, which has duly been verified vide order dated 18.04.2022, the certified copy of the same is available on record.

It was submitted that in view of aforesaid facts and circumstances, no useful purpose would be served by keeping the impugned proceedings pending and thus, the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.
4. Learned A.G.A. has no objection if parties compromise the matter.
5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.

sentences.text: It is well settled that in appropriate cases criminal proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise between the parties, by invoking inherent powers enshrined under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
In the instant case matter relates to matrimonial dispute, which is private in nature.
If parties compromise the matter, it would not have adverse impact on society.
There is nothing to indicate that parties have any criminal antecedents.
The compromise arrived at between the parties has already been verified by the trial Court concerned.
Considering aforesaid facts of the matter, it would be in the interest of justice that the impugned proceedings be quashed.
7. In view of the aforesaid, the entire impugned proceedings of the aforesaid case, against applicants, namely, Ashutosh Ojha & Prabha Ojha are hereby quashed.
8. The application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

(Raj Beer Singh,J.) September 8, 2025 'SP'/-
